full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white high-speed photograph freezes a burst of liquid at the moment it rises from a shallow vessel. A low, dark rectangular platform spans the lower part of the frame, and a thin bright horizontal rim just above it marks the surface that receives the splash. At the center, an intensely white bowl-shaped mass of water lifts above the rim. Its upper edge breaks into narrow looping arcs, branching strands, and fine filaments that reach out left and right like a temporary crown. Hundreds of tiny droplets scatter above these arcs. They form a tapered, mistlike column running up the center of the image, with individual bright points more widely dispersed toward the top. The broad black background contains no visible room detail or competing object, allowing even the smallest suspended droplets to register. A little light catches the floor or tabletop around the platform near the bottom edge, but that surface stays subdued. The splash is symmetrical only in its overall spread; each strand twists irregularly, some reconnecting with the bowl while others end as isolated beads. A strong, brief light source exposes the white water sharply against the darkness, giving the event a sculptural look. The eye reads the picture from the steady horizontal base through the shallow liquid cup, then up the lively mesh of arcs and suspended spray. The image makes an extremely short physical instant visible and still, with contrast, frozen motion, and the delicate difference between continuous liquid and separate droplets supplying all of its drama.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白高速照片凝固液体从浅容器里跃起的瞬间。低矮的深色矩形平台横跨画面下部，其上方一道细亮横线标明承接水花的表面。中央，一团极亮、碗状的水体升到边沿之上；上缘分裂成狭窄的环弧、分叉水线与细丝，向左右伸开，像一顶转瞬即逝的冠。数百颗极小水滴散在这些弧线之上，沿画面中央形成向上收窄的雾状柱，越到高处独立亮点越稀疏。宽阔黑背景没有可见的房间细节或竞争物件，因此最细小的悬空水滴也能显现。少许亮光擦过画面底缘附近平台周围的地面或桌面，但该处仍然低调。水花仅在整体扩展上近似对称，每条水线都不规则扭转；有的重新接回水碗，有的终结为孤立珠点。强而短暂的光源把白色水体清晰地从黑暗中揭出，使事件有雕塑般的外观。视线从稳定的水平基座经过浅浅的液体碗，再上行到活跃的弧线网和悬浮飞沫。照片让极短的物理瞬间可见而静止，反差、凝固运动以及连续水体与分离水滴之间的细微差别构成全部张力。
style_prompt_en: High-speed experimental monochrome photography that isolates a fleeting physical event in a dark studio. Build a simple structure from one stable horizontal base and one sharply frozen, irregular burst above it. Deep black negative space should surround the event, while hard brief illumination turns thin filaments, beads, and textured surfaces brilliant white. Keep the main form crisp enough to distinguish continuous strands from detached particles, yet allow a fine halo of spray to soften the boundary at its outermost edge. Contrast is bold, but the grayscale within the bright material retains delicate details rather than clipping into featureless white. The composition is centered and spacious, giving every outward arc room to read. It feels scientific in its clear observation and sculptural in its attention to shape, using precise timing and light to reveal an otherwise invisible instant.
style_prompt_zh: 高速实验性黑白摄影在暗色影棚中隔离转瞬即逝的物理事件。结构由一道稳定水平基线和其上方一团锐利凝固、不规则爆发的形体组成。深黑留白环绕事件，强而短促的光把细丝、珠点和有肌理的表面照成明白色。主体要足够清晰，能分辨连续水线与脱离的颗粒；最外缘的细飞沫又可形成柔和光晕。反差大胆，但亮部材料内部保留精细灰阶，而非裁成无特征纯白。构图居中且宽敞，让每一道外伸弧线都有可辨空间。它以清楚观察显得科学，又因重视形状而具有雕塑感，通过精确时机与光线揭露平时看不见的瞬间。
theme_en: A high-speed black-and-white photograph freezes a bright water splash against darkness
theme_zh: 一幅高速黑白摄影在黑暗背景前凝固一道明亮水花
name: Harold Edgerton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
